title: Output Schema for SendMessageBatch Operation
description: Output schema for the sendMessageBatch operation in the connector.

payload.description: The main response payload from the sendMessageBatch operation.

Successful.description: A list of SendMessageBatchResultEntry items for successfully sent messages.

Id.description: The user-supplied ID for the message.

MessageId.description: The SQS-assigned ID for the message.

MD5OfMessageBody.description: An MD5 digest of the message body.

MD5OfMessageAttributes.description: An MD5 digest of the message attributes (if any).

SequenceNumber.description: The sequence number for messages sent to a FIFO queue.

Failed.description: A list of BatchResultErrorEntry items for messages that failed to send.

Id.description: The user-supplied ID for the message.

SenderFault.description: Indicates whether the error was on the sender's side.

operationSuccessful.description: Indicates whether the SQS API call was successful (does not mean all batch items succeeded).

requestId.description: The AWS request ID for the SQS operation.
